messages:
nora: Quick note - onboarding customers reported double-charges from payments webhooks when running the docker-compose sample locally in CI. Seen during scale test.
kevin: any logs? which SDK?
nora: C# SDK + sampleapp compose. Logs: 
```
2026-03-23T02:10:05.120Z WARN retry: got 429, attempt=1 backoff_ms=0 request=tx_9001
2026-03-23T02:10:05.121Z INFO sender: POST /webhook tx_9001 idempotency=missing
2026-03-23T02:10:05.322Z INFO retry: attempt=2 backoff_ms=0 request=tx_9001
2026-03-23T02:10:05.323Z INFO sender: POST /webhook tx_9001 idempotency=missing
```
nora: two POSTs 200ms apart. backoff is 0 because dev mode sets deterministic schedule for reproducing rare races.
pat: hmm C# RNG seed uses Process.GetCurrentProcess().Id ^ Environment.TickCount; in docker-compose many containers get PIDs in same range and TickCount aligned, RNG ended up identical across replicas.
kevin: so we had synchronized jitter+no idempotency header. surprising sampleapp doesn't add Idempotency-Key by default?
nora: sampleapp had `USE_SAFE_REPLAY=false` in compose.override to make test output simpler. that was the mistake.
pat: recommended fix: 1) change sampleapp defaults to `USE_SAFE_REPLAY=true`; 2) change C# SDK to always generate an Idempotency-Key unless explicitly disabled; 3) make deterministic/repro flags opt-in per-developer, not global env that CI copies.
kevin: also change RNG seeding to use RNGCryptoServiceProvider (or RandomNumberGenerator) on startup so separate processes don't correlate.
nora: small UX tweak: when dev determinism is enabled, emit a runtime warning: "deterministic retries may cause duplicate side-effects when running multi-process or clustered setups". link to docs.
ops-bot: created ticket #INF-2789: "sampleapp: opt-in deterministic backoff causes duplicate webhook deliveries" assigned to @kevin.
ci-bot: added a flaky test: thundering_herd_sim in nightly pipeline.
pat: action items: kevin -> SDK PR to attach Idempotency-Key by default and reseed RNG; nora -> update compose.override and README; ci -> enable herd sim nightly. anyone object?
kevin: opening PR after standup.
pat: will validate on staging with load test.
nora: thanks all, adding note to onboarding checklist: "do not run deterministic backoff configs in CI or multi-container dev clusters" :warning:
